EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting ASU College of Nursing and Health Innovation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName}, Thank you for your interest in Patient Safety and Health Care Quality. Arizona State University is a nationally recognized leader in higher education. Our graduate programs rank in the top 4% for best graduate nursing programs (US News and World Report). We encourage you to consider joining one of our nationally ranked graduate programs.
Our patient safety and health care quality programs provide registered nurses with advanced preparation in nursing practice and the ability to translate concepts, practices and principles of safety and improvement science to enhance safe, effective patient care.
Conveniently offered in a hybrid format, our Patient Safety and Health Care Quality programs meet in-person twice per semester. This schedule provides flexibility for our working nurse professionals.
MS Nursing (Patient Safety and Health Care Quality) https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/majorinfo/ASU00/NUPSHCMS/graduate/false
Patient Safety and Health Care Quality (graduate certificate) https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/majorinfo/ASU00/NUPSHCGRCT/graduate/false
Graduates are specialists able to: synthesize innovation principles and best available evidence to develop interventions for implementation; and, lead interprofessional teams to design, deliver, and evaluate safety and quality improvement efforts that are patient centered, minimize risk, and improve outcomes across diverse practice settings.
Both the master’s degree and certificate option provide an opportunity to prepare for national certification as a Certified Professional in Health Care Quality (CPHQ) and Certified Patient Safety Officer (CPSO).
Benefits of graduate study at ASU
Growing your career and leading others Gaining broader perspectives on global health challenges Surrounding yourself with expert faculty and quality mentors Preparing to positively impact health outcomes Applying theory and research to advance practice
We hope you will continue to consider Arizona State University for graduate education. Recruitment and Admissions College of Nursing and Health Innovation Phone: (602) 496-0937 Office Hours: Monday - Friday, 8a.m. - 5p.m. conhi_undergrad@asu.edu https://nursingandhealth.asu.edu
